VICEPORT CODEX

DESKTOP

  • WASD Move
  • Mouse Look / aim
  • Shift Sprint
  • Space Jump
  • C Crouch
  • E Interact / enter
  • Left click Fire
  • Right click Aim
  • R Reload
  • F Enter vehicle
  • Q Phone
  • M Map
  • 1-8 Weapons
  • Esc Pause

MOBILE

Left stick moves. Drag the right side of the screen to look. Buttons appear for fire, aim, jump, sprint, interact and reload. Tap the minimap to open the full city map. Tap the phone button for the smartphone.

WANTED

Crimes raise heat. Break line of sight and stay out of the search radius until the stars fade. Higher heat brings roadblocks, tactical units and helicopters.

DISTRICTS

Downtown · Solano Beach · Mariposa Heights · Little Havana · Ironworks · Sandhill · Kingsport Airport · Fort Caldera · Redwood Ridge · The Docks · Palmetto Mall · Neon Strip.

MONEY

Complete story jobs, side jobs and random events. Buy safehouses, garages, weapons, clothes and rides. Vehicles delivered from the garage phone app.

SETTINGS

Changes apply immediately and are saved with your progress.
